blocks.text: A South Korean man convicted of killing three Koreans in the Philippines and accused of running a major drug distribution network while behind bars had plotted to escape prison by flying over its walls while suspended from a heavy-duty drone, according to a report aired Monday. Park Wang-yeol, 47, devised the plan shortly before he was temporarily transferred to South Korea in March, local broadcaster JTBC reported.
